source: Source: bluewin.ch, Swiss watch exports, reported 28 November 2026

slides.label: Swiss watch exports · October
slides.headline: Up 9.1% in October
slides.body: Swiss watches shipped abroad were worth CHF 2.46 billion, more than in October last year.

slides.label: Where the growth went
slides.headline: The US grew the most
slides.body: US exports rose about 61% in October, but the US is still slightly down over the first ten months.

slides.label: The backdrop
slides.headline: A 39% US tariff looms
slides.body: The US put a 39% tariff on Swiss goods in August 2025.

slides.label: The full year so far
slides.headline: The year is still up overall
slides.body: Exports for January to October reached CHF 21.9 billion, up on the same period last year.
